findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: json_schema_validate, kdp_preflight, pdf_info · Private data: csv_profile, dns_lookup, html_to_image, html_to_pdf, image_convert, ip_lookup, json_schema_validate, json_yaml_convert, kdp_preflight, kdp_puzzle_book, kdp_report, markdown_render, pdf_info, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_text, qr_code, rdap_lookup, screenshot, svg_to_png, tabular_convert · Public sink: kdp_puzzle_book · Destructive: markdown_render, tabular_convert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: json_schema_validate, kdp_preflight, pdf_info · Private data: csv_profile, dns_lookup, html_to_image, html_to_pdf, image_convert, ip_lookup, json_schema_validate, json_yaml_convert, kdp_preflight, kdp_puzzle_book, kdp_report, markdown_render, pdf_info, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_text, qr_code, rdap_lookup, screenshot, svg_to_png, tabular_convert · Public sink: kdp_puzzle_book · Destructive: markdown_render, tabular_convert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
